The '''EV2 discreet reconnaissance macrobinoculars''' was a [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|Macrobinoculars]] designed and produced by the legendary spymaster known as [[The Shroud (Human)|The Shroud]]. Named after one of his top lieutenants [[Evie Bo]], the EV2 model possessed top-notch features such as supreme-resolution zoom, wide-spectrum environmental analysis, full voice/data communications and an omnioptic interface for [[Miraluka/Legends|Miralukas]]. The Shroud contracted the components separately across the galaxy and oversaw the assembly himself. The macrobinoculars were fitted with anti-tamper explosive charges embedded into the framework to prevent reverse engineering.<ref name="SWTOR" />

Despite all the precaution, a copy of EV2 was lost when Evie Bo herself defected to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and informed [[Darth Mortis]] about Shroud's plan to attack [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Around the same time, a copy was obtained by [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] agent [[Deena Riss]]. Since the devices provided exclusive access to the Shroud's technology, they proved invaluable in preventing his planned terrorist attacks.<ref name="ROTHC">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
EV2 discreet reconnaissance macrobinoculars appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' during the Shroud's gambit story arc.
